title: LSP smoke test configuration
description: Configuration of the LSP smoke test, read from smoke.yaml in the fixture directory.

file.description: The file to open, relative to the fixture directory.

server.description: Name of the LSP session. Defaults to the package name. Only needed for plugins whose name differs from the package name.

expect.description: What to check. Either `start`, which only checks that the server starts, or a mapping describing the expected diagnostics.

oneOf.description: Only check that the server starts.

startup_timeout.description: Seconds to wait for the server to start, including downloading or installing it.

diagnostics_timeout.description: Seconds to wait for the expected diagnostics after the server has started.

diagnostics.description: Wait for at least `min_diagnostics` diagnostics matching all of the given keys.

severity.description: The diagnostic's `severity`: 1 = error, 2 = warning, 3 = information, 4 = hint.

message.description: A regular expression that the diagnostic's `message` must match.
